data.exact_reserve_text: The underwriting result was a loss of GBP 28.2m, of which GBP 22.8m is in respect of the 2018 and prior years of account. The main driver of this deterioration was a substantial increase in new large and cat claims, particularly in the fourth quarter. Additional reserves were booked in relation to COVID-19 at GBP 12.0m net, of which GBP 7.2m related to 2018 and prior years of account.

named_events.loss_description: Net loss to the syndicate relating to pandemic business interruption exposures; reserves held at year end for COVID-19 are GBP 12.0m net (UK BI net reserve GBP 8.8m, US net reserve GBP 1.7m, Australian net reserve GBP 0.9m, UK Travel net reserve GBP 0.6m).
Listed as one of the largest events during 2020 with estimated gross and net loss to the syndicate.

data.standardized_narrative: During 2020 the syndicate's gross prior-year claims reserves deteriorated materially: analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a gross adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 114.4m. The deterioration was driven by large new and catastrophic claims (notably adverse development in casualty exposures), and additional COVID-19 related reserve strengthening. Legal and reinsurance uncertainty (including court actions and uncertainty over reinsurance to close availability/cost) also contributed to reserve strengthening. The 2018 year of account remains open and carries material exposure to COVID-19.
raw_causal_phrases: substantial increase in new large and cat claims, particularly in the fourth quarter
Additional reserves were booked in relation to COVID-19 at GBP 12.0m net, of which GBP 7.2m related to 2018 and prior years of account.
The final outcome of these claims is still uncertain together with related reinsurance recoveries
There is significant uncertainty as to the cost and availability of reinsurance to close via a third party.
loss ratios, capital ratios, expense ratios and acquisition costs have all been too high
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure derived from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative estimates by underwriting year) because the report does not publish a single labelled 'gross prior year movement' figure. The syndicate had Part VII / reinsurance-to-close transactions near year-end and ongoing reinsurance uncertainties which may affect comparability; many narrative amounts are reported net of reinsurance, but the PYD above is calculated on gross triangle data. Triangle numbers are presented in thousands in the source tables; main monetary fields in this output are converted to millions.
